episodes.title: How the Cult of 12-Step Uses Control & Isolation to Keep You Coming Back
episodes.description: Discover the shocking truth behind the 12-step program and how it uses isolation and control to keep you coming back. This video exposes the cult-like tactics used by 12-step groups to maintain a grip on their members, often under the guise of recovery and support. By manipulating individuals through isolation and control, these groups can lead to a loss of autonomy, financial exploitation, and emotional distress. Learn how to recognize the warning signs of cult-like behavior and break free from the cycle of dependence. If you or someone you know is involved in a 12-step program, this video is a must-watch to understand the potential risks and dangers. Get informed, get educated, and take back control of your life.

episodes.title: YES! The Cult of 12-Step Has "Leaders" Who Try to Keep You Trapped
episodes.description: Yes, there is a clear leader in 12-Step programs and there always has been. From Bill Wilson to now. If there are claims of exclusive knowledge of truth and a demand to loyalty and any questioning or criticizing is met with authoritarian shut-down, then that points to a clear leader and a program that operates as a cult.
